source.name: Binance Public Data / Binance Vision
source.format: monthly ZIP archives containing CSV-form kline rows

timestamp_contract.guard: Reject any parsed open_time or close_time whose magnitude/unit is inconsistent with milliseconds or whose converted timestamp lies outside the archive month.
timestamp_contract.reason: The official Binance public-data documentation states that spot timestamps from 2025-01-01 onward use microseconds. Cohort 01 intentionally freezes pre-2025 archives to avoid a timestamp-unit regime change in the first benchmark.

validation_gates_before_modeling: Fetch all 60 ZIP archives and all 60 official .CHECKSUM files.
Verify each ZIP against the official checksum before extraction.
Record the observed archive SHA-256, checksum-file SHA-256, byte size, and retrieval timestamp for every month in data_manifest.lock.json.
Require strictly increasing unique open_time after concatenation.
Require high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), high >= low, positive prices, and nonnegative volumes/trade counts.
Require close_time > open_time for every row.
Enumerate every deviation from exact 1-hour open_time spacing. Do not forward-fill or synthesize missing bars.
Fail closed on conflicting duplicate timestamps.
Compute a SHA-256 over the canonical concatenated raw-row bytes after successful archive verification and record it in data_manifest.lock.json.
Commit data_manifest.lock.json and data_quality_report.json before any validation/model-selection run; held-out test remains locked until independent reviewer sign-off.

gap_exclusion_rule.rule: A sample is eligible only when every hourly bar from t-168 through t+2 required by its frozen features/label exists exactly once. Samples touching a gap or duplicate are excluded before split-level metrics, and counts/reasons are reported without replacement or imputation.

mutation_policy: If Binance later replaces an archived file or checksum, do not update this dataset silently. Create a new dataset_id/version, preserve the old manifest, rerun only under a documented amendment, and do not choose the version based on held-out performance.
